A quality-control analyst must check an extracted SYNOP report. Use the report's Section 1 1snTTT and 2snTdTdTd groups for air temperature and dew point in Celsius. Compute air temperature minus dew point. In Section 3 interpret group 59ppp as a 24-hour pressure decrease in tenths of hPa, and group 7R24R24R24R24 as the 24-hour precipitation amount in tenths of a millimetre. A reviewer proposed that 70020 means 20 mm; test that proposal. The code text and specified rules are supplied, not independent verification that the station observed the values.

AAXX 31031 41850 01450 8//00 10222 20210 30087 40188 70522 8852/ 333 20213 59008 70020==

Return exactly one JSON object with exactly the requested keys. Use JSON booleans, numbers and null as specified; no prose or Markdown. Keys: air_temperature_c (number); dewpoint_c (number); temperature_dewpoint_spread_c (number); pressure_change_24h_hpa (signed number); precipitation_24h_mm (number); proposed_20mm_correct (boolean); independently_verified_station_observation (boolean).
